ui.heading: Get started in 6 steps
ui.sub: Follow the real workflow, from the electricity bill to the client documents
ui.dontShow: Do not open this automatically again
ui.finishBody: For the details of each step, open the full manual from the tab above. The manual itself is in Thai.

steps.title: Analyse the electricity bill
steps.caption: Find out how much power the client uses, and when. The design can only be sized correctly once you know the real load.
bullets: Enter 12 months of bills, or import an AMR file from the utility
AMR gives hourly data, so it is far more accurate than bills
Export the DB0 file before moving on
steps.note: You may skip this step if there is no bill yet, but the payback figures will then be based on assumptions.

steps.title: Project details and equipment
steps.caption: Pin the real site location, then pick the modules and inverter from the equipment library.
bullets: Search for the site or type the coordinates and the map will move there
Pick a brand, then a model, from the library of 155 items
Anything not in the library can be uploaded as a datasheet file
steps.note: Choose the equipment before drawing the roof. The layout uses the real module dimensions, so changing the model later recalculates the whole panel grid and every string.

steps.title: Draw the roof and place panels
steps.caption: Trace the roof edges on satellite imagery, then the program lays out the panels and splits the strings for you.
bullets: Draw one roof plane at a time; azimuth and slope are derived for you
Mark obstructions and walkways and the panels keep clear of them
Installed capacity and panel count update live in the bottom bar
steps.note: If the satellite imagery is not sharp enough, add your own map key for deeper zoom, or use the drone-image tool with ground control points, which beats every satellite provider.

steps.title: Engineering and design check
steps.caption: Produces the bill of materials, the single line diagram, and 36 checks that each cite a clause of the Thai EIT standard.
bullets: Press Generate BOM to build the material list and the SLD
Run the design check to see which items fail the standard
Export DB2 to carry the design into the other menus
steps.note: Press Generate BOM again after every design change, otherwise the material list and the quoted price still describe the old design.

steps.title: 3D model and equipment layout
steps.caption: See the shadows as they actually fall through the day, and place equipment on a real photo of the wall at true scale.
bullets: Drag the time slider to see morning and afternoon shading
Export a still image, or a .glb model you can drop into PowerPoint and rotate
Menu 4 places inverters and boards on a real site photo
steps.note: Older DB2 files show only the building box with no panels, because the roof outline is not in the file. Open the project in the design page and export DB2 again.

steps.title: Report and client documents
steps.caption: Simulates a full year hour by hour, then produces the complete document set for the client.
bullets: Import DB2 and run the simulation to get all 8,760 hours
Gives payback, IRR, NPV and the P50 P75 P90 confidence range
Produces the engineering report, proposal, quotation and installer brief
steps.note: Choose Thai or English before exporting the PDF. Every number is identical in both languages.
